hypothesis: Dense recorded combat-consequence supervision improves transferable state representations before the unchanged E160 terminal action-improvement task.
auxiliary_targets: Net HP change divided by pre-map max HP through the next outside state or terminal
Survival through that same entire transition; Act3 without Heart is alive, not a combat death
scope: All deduplicated accepted old map actions with visible monster, elite or boss destination. No unknown/event destinations, inferred alternate outcomes or new trajectories. Consecutive Act3 bosses form one transition.
family_roles: Original E73 three folds, original inner split. Fit auxiliary encoder only on inner training families for inner Heart fits; refit on outer fitting families for final fold actor. Seeds, fingerprints, post-action state and future outcomes are labels/provenance only.
selection: Auxiliary stopping uses inner validation equal-weight family-then-transition MSE. Fixed 8192 outer draws screen prediction against an act x visible destination x pre-HP quartile mean fitted only on fitting families. Aggregate MSE at most90% of baseline and better in each fold required before Heart fitting.
heart_gate: Keep E160 stopping, sampling, inputs, categorical support, terminal gain/tie/loss labels and P(gain)-P(loss) deployment. Required fit known gains at least half of available improvements, fit gains greater than losses, held gains greater than losses. Unknown actions remain unknown.
comparison_limits: A coherent pretraining procedure adds optimization and existing dense supervision; no claim of isolated parameter-budget causality. Dense prediction success alone is not policy improvement. No production adoption or unseen acceptance from this study.
